release_policy.budget_rule: One fully tested deliberate release per individually approved bundle. Current deployable Personal plan credits are owner-monitored, not the separate operational allowance. Known insufficiency below 15 credits, credit data tampering, or an expired known grant blocks publishing. Never infer current billing from a dated screenshot. Keep user-authorized publish marker; no automatic source/docs or preview deployment. No plan purchases, unapproved recharge, weakening beta SSO, access, data privacy or recovery controls.
release_policy.manual_refresh_required: Owner assumes monitoring of Netlify credits and promises to alert when low; do not ask for routine screenshots or require a new billing read for each release during the current unexpired credit grant. After a known plan-grant expiration, verify that the applicable plan and credit availability are still valid, with the owner's consent. The plugin does not expose live credits.
release_policy.purchase_permission: No plan upgrades, manual credit purchases or automatic recharges without separate explicit owner approval.
release_policy.after_downgrade: Re-verify balance and actual Free plan allowance; preserve release marker and a fresh, conservative 15-credit minimum.
